general.notes: Bit rate support stated as 125 to 622Mbps (not Gbps). Power budget 17–41dB @ STM4/OC12. Dispersion penalty max 1dB (no paired penalized value/condition for penalties schema). Transmitter output min printed as +4.0dB; max as +7.0dBm; footnote 1) average power. Rx sensitivity at BER 1x10-12, PRBS 223-1: STM4/OC12 -37dBm, STM1/OC3 -38dBm, 100M FE -39dBm. Nominal wavelength listed as 1470–1610nm (9ch) in table vs 8 CWDM wavelengths 1471–1611nm in overview. Operating temperature printed as -0°C to +70°C. Power consumption < 1.0W. Reach 160km dependent on actual optical path attenuation; lower CWDM channel 1471nm faces higher fiber attenuation. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C (not normal operating). Transmission media SM (2x LC).
